name: Preachers Salary
overview: Scripture affirms that those who labor in preaching and teaching the Word are deserving of material support, as illustrated by the instruction to accept hospitality because 'the laborer is worthy of his hire' (Luke 10:7). While Paul exemplifies personal integrity by not coveting financial gain (Acts 20:33), believers who receive spiritual instruction are encouraged to share generously with their teachers in all good things (Galatians 6:6). Together, these verses emphasize a balanced perspective that honors both the dignity of the preacher's work and the responsibility of the congregation to provide for their needs.
